description: Replies to the sender of one received email, and only to them (no Cc, no Bcc, no attachment), from the address the email was written to. What happens next is the level the user set in BumbleBox for this kind of reply: a draft, a reply waiting for one tap (the default), or a reply that leaves after a delay the user can cancel. Anything that commits the user (amounts, bank details, acceptance, contracts, dates, links) always waits for the user, and so does a reply from an address the user has not verified (needsIdentity). The result says which one applied.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.
